artifacts.summary: 6-phase plan for session-scoped stash provenance and a tree-state-blind foreign-pop refusal in guard-destructive-git.sh.

memory_candidates.content: In guard-destructive-git.sh (agent-system/extensions/core/hooks/), the clean-tree early exit (git status --porcelain empty -> exit 0) sits ABOVE most destructive-command detectors. Any new hazard whose damage does not depend on working-tree dirtiness -- a history rewrite, or dropping someone else's stash entry via a pop that has nothing of its own to apply -- must be implemented as a tree-state-blind predicate placed BEFORE that early exit, carrying its own inline grant check and its own exit 2, and must NOT reuse the downstream MATCHED/snapshot-marker flow. The snapshot-marker exemption is also wrong for such hazards: a snapshot of our own tree does not make another session's lost stash entry recoverable. The existing hazard-class-2 history-rewrite predicate in the same file is the structural model to copy.
